Title: Generally Available: Azure Functions extension for Dapr

Body.Content:
Azure Functions extension for Dapr is now in generally available.

You can use Dapr’s powerful cloud native building block APIs (e.g. Service Invoke with service discovery & mTLS, PubSub, Bindings, Secrets and Actors) and a large array of ecosystem components in the native and friendly Azure Functions triggers & bindings programming model.  The extension is available to run on AKS and ACA services. 

Learn more.
